resources.string:
"Duress password can be entered instead of the user password in any place that asks for it, such as the lock screen of any user and any user or work profile password prompt.
Submitting the duress password will immediately make the storage contents permanently inaccessible, delete all eSIMs and then power off the device. DiamaneOS will remain installed.
Duress PIN works the same way duress password does."
Improves compatibility by disabling some of the DiamaneOS exploit protections for this app

The Play Integrity API allows services to verify properties of a device through their app. Some services accept only the operating system that the device was sold with, so their apps may not work on DiamaneOS. If an app does not work, you can contact its developer.
